role.zh: 信息学与数据科学 · 博士研究生

affiliation.zh: 广岛大学 · 复杂系统科学研究室
affiliation.en: Hiroshima University · Complex Systems Science Lab

introduction.zh: 我关注多智能体系统中的感知与协作，研究机器人如何共同搬运未知物体，以及如何为复杂人群设计自适应引导方法。
introduction.en: I study perception and cooperation in multi-agent systems, with a focus on cooperative robotic transport and adaptive guidance for complex crowds.

zh: 我是 Kaixin Wu（开心），广岛大学复杂系统科学研究室的信息学与数据科学博士研究生。
我的研究兴趣包括多智能体系统、机器人协作与人群引导，也关注这些研究如何走向实际应用。
en: I am Kaixin Wu, a Ph.D. student in informatics and data science at the Complex Systems Science Laboratory, Hiroshima University.
My interests include multi-agent systems, robotic cooperation and crowd guidance, as well as translating research into practical applications.

title.zh: 未知物体，如何共同搬运？

summary.zh: 探索多个机器人如何在缺少物体先验形状信息的情况下，通过局部感知与协作完成搬运任务。
summary.en: Exploring how multiple robots can use local sensing and cooperation to transport objects without prior knowledge of their shape.

projects.english_title: Adaptive Guide-Agent Deployment for Unknown Dynamic Crowds

title.zh: 有限资源，如何引导复杂人群？

summary.zh: 研究如何根据人群分布安排引导智能体，并逐步探索适应环境变化的协作引导方法。
summary.en: Studying how guide agents can be deployed around crowds, with the longer-term goal of adapting to changing environments.
